o.command:
import maya.cmds as cmds
import maya.mel as mel

slider = mel.eval('$tmpVar=$gPlayBackSlider')
r = cmds.timeControl(slider, q=True, rangeArray=True)
sel_start = r[0]
sel_end = r[1] - 1

focused = cmds.optionVar(q='tlmFocusRangeActive') if cmds.optionVar(exists='tlmFocusRangeActive') else 0

if focused:
    cmds.playbackOptions(
        min=cmds.optionVar(q='tlmFocusRangeShotMin'),
        max=cmds.optionVar(q='tlmFocusRangeShotMax'))
    cmds.optionVar(iv=('tlmFocusRangeActive', 0))
else:
    if sel_end > sel_start:
        cmds.optionVar(fv=('tlmFocusRangeShotMin', cmds.playbackOptions(q=True, min=True)))
        cmds.optionVar(fv=('tlmFocusRangeShotMax', cmds.playbackOptions(q=True, max=True)))
        cmds.playbackOptions(min=sel_start, max=sel_end)
        cmds.optionVar(iv=('tlmFocusRangeActive', 1))
